detection_bypass_claims: GitHub-signed provenance is valid because the source was already compromised when it was signed.
Domain reputation does not help: stage 1 comes from github.com and the C2 address is resolved on chain at runtime.
npm ci --ignore-scripts is insufficient. Two of the three execution triggers are IDE and agent hooks that do not run install scripts.
hunting_notes: Hunt @opensearch/setup as a dependency name across package.json and every lockfile. It needs no new telemetry, and a hit is unambiguous - no legitimate package declares it.
The affected-version table is the rollback source. A hit needs a named safe version in the same row or the ticket cannot be actioned.
Bun/1.3.13 is a user-agent string, so it is only visible where request user agents are logged - proxy or egress telemetry, not endpoint file events. Do not present it as endpoint coverage.
StringListStore is the contract type name, not an indicator. The contract address is the indicator and the corpus already carries it.
The cross-wiring is the operationally important claim: a host where only .claude was cleaned is still triggered from .vscode. Eradication verification has to check both.
